history_orphans: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphan_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT h.issueid) AS orphan_issues FROM issues_change_history h LEFT JOIN issues i ON h.issueid=i.id WHERE i.id IS NULL
snapshot_orphans: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphan_rows FROM issues_snapshot s LEFT JOIN issues i ON s.id=i.id WHERE i.id IS NULL
text_orphans: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphan_rows FROM sample_utterances t LEFT JOIN issues i ON t.issueid=i.id WHERE i.id IS NULL
issues_without_history: SELECT COUNT(*) AS issues FROM issues i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issues_change_history h WHERE h.issueid=i.id)
history_coverage: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT issueid) AS issues FROM issues_change_history
snapshot_coverage: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS issues FROM issues_snapshot
text_coverage: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT issueid) AS issues FROM sample_utterances
